hotel.name: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort edges the sand and surf of Khem Beach on Phu Quoc.
verified_facts.excerpt: Edging the sand and surf of Khem Beach, JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort and Spa is a luxury haven

verified_facts.text: Architect Bill Bensley designed the resort around the story of a fictional 19th-century French university.
verified_facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Phu Quoc, designed by the legendary Bill Bensley, offers a unique blend of luxury and whimsy, set against the backdrop of a fictional 19th-century French university.

verified_facts.text: In the resort's story, classrooms became guest rooms and the old mushroom mycology wharf became Chanterelle Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Classrooms were artfully converted into guest rooms, offices transformed into welcoming public spaces, and the old mushroom mycology wharf was reborn as the enchanting Chanterelle Spa.

verified_facts.text: The Dean's Library, home to more than 1,500 books, is now the resort's reception lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to a collection of more than 1,500 books, the Dean's Library is now remastered into the resort reception lobby

verified_facts.text: The Chanterelle Spa's design is inspired by Alice in Wonderland.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into a world of enchantment at the Chanterelle - Spa by JW, where the design is inspired by the whimsical wonder of Alice in Wonderland.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers locally inspired massages, beauty treatments and wellness therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy a comprehensive menu of locally inspired massages, beauty treatments, and luxurious wellness therapies

verified_facts.text: The beachfront Sand Pool, Shell Pool and Sun Pool are designed so the pool's edge meets the sandy beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: These award-winning pools feature designs that blend with the coastal landscape, forming a visual masterpiece where the pool's edge meets the sandy beach.

verified_facts.text: Each room is influenced by a fictional academic department within the signature Indochine design.
verified_facts.excerpt: each room is influenced by a fictional academic department, incorporated into the signature Indochine design

verified_facts.text: All accommodations feature a spacious balcony with a sofa bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: All accommodations feature a spacious balcony with a sofa bed, offering scenic views of the garden and ocean.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms feature double-height windows, dual washbasins, soaking tubs and marble tiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort's thoughtfully designed bathrooms feature expansive double-height windows, dual washbasins, spacious soaking tubs, and elegant marble tiles

verified_facts.text: The resort has private pool villas with one, three or seven bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: the resort's private pool villas will elevate your family island getaway, with options of one-bedroom, three-bedroom or seven-bedroom

verified_facts.text: The Department of Chemistry Bar is lab-themed, with glassware and a periodic table on the ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: with glassware, eperimental décor, and a periodic table on the ceiling creating a unique ambiance

verified_facts.text: Complimentary activities include kayaking and sunrise yoga.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore complimentary activities at this Phu Quoc resort with pools such as kayaking, sunrise yoga, and more

verified_facts.text: Khem Beach has gentle waves and clear water, making it family-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Khem Beach boasts gentle waves that resemble a tranquil melody, and the crystal-clear sea reveals the small fish dwelling within.

verified_facts.text: The Little Explorers Club offers arts and crafts, interactive games and themed workshops for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: the club offers a variety of engaging activities, from arts and crafts to interactive games and themed workshops

verified_facts.text: The resort is 10 minutes from Sunset Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: just 10 minutes from the vibrant Sunset Town

verified_facts.text: Guests get complimentary access to the Kiss of the Sea show.
verified_facts.excerpt: complimentary access to the spectacular Kiss of the Sea

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a Lamarck University tour of the resort's story and architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through our university tour steeped in mysterious stories, discover the harmony of Eastern and Western architecture with vibrant colors

verified_facts.text: Rue De Lamarck is a street of converted buildings housing the spa, gift shops and dining venues, with a Hoi An walking-street feel.
verified_facts.excerpt: the whole street has the same feel as some of Hoi An’s famous walking streets

verified_facts.text: The resort received Green Globe certification in 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2024, our Vietnam resort was honoured with the prestigious Green Globe certification

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says Bensley takes the university theme to extremes in the public spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Although he takes the theme to extremes in the public spaces

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler places the resort on the southern shore of Phu Quoc.
verified_facts.excerpt: here on Kem Beach, on the southern shore of Phu Quoc
